trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Aegean Bliss Resort, Disney World, Orlando, Florida

day_by_day.morning: No morning activities — flight arrives at 13:00. Rest and travel time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 13:00. Take the Sunshine Flyer or Disney's Magical Express alternative (budget shuttle ~$16–$20/person) to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack, and explore the resort grounds, pool area, and beachfront. Pick up a resort map and plan the week ahead.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required) via complimentary resort shuttle. Browse the shops, enjoy live entertainment, and soak in the Disney atmosphere. Great low-cost way to kick off the trip.

meals.breakfast: Grab a snack or meal at the airport before landing — budget $8–$12 at a terminal food court.
meals.lunch: Eat at the airport or grab a quick bite at the resort food court upon arrival (~$10–$14 per person).
meals.dinner: Chicken Guy! at Disney Springs — casual, affordable, and delicious. Budget ~$12–$15 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Day 1 is intentionally light. Use the evening to rest, rehydrate, and get oriented. Purchase a refillable resort mug if available for savings on drinks throughout the stay. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

day_by_day.morning: Arrive at Magic Kingdom when gates open (typically 8:00–9:00 AM). Head immediately to Tomorrowland or Fantasyland to ride top attractions before crowds build. Prioritize Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train using Lightning Lane if budget allows.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise) and Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion). Take a mid-afternoon break during peak heat (2:00–4:00 PM) — rest near the castle or grab a shaded snack spot to save energy.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Main Street Electrical Parade or the Happily Ever After fireworks show (check schedule). These are free with park admission and are absolute highlights. Exit after fireworks via resort shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort food court before heading out — oatmeal, eggs, or pastries ~$6–$10 per person.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — affordable counter-service with sandwiches and chowder ~$12–$15 per person.
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's best budget counter-service options. ~$12–$16 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Magic Kingdom is the most iconic park — arrive early to maximize time. Wear comfortable shoes and bring a refillable water bottle (free water is available at quick-service locations). Check the My Disney Experience app for real-time wait times.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for rope drop (typically 9:00 AM). Start in World Discovery — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track early before lines spike. Use the My Disney Experience app to grab virtual queues if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stroll through the World Showcase countries (opens at 11:00 AM). Explore Mexico, Norway (Frozen Ever After ride), China, Italy, and more. This is a budget-friendly way to experience global culture, food, and entertainment without extra costs.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's HarmonioUS nighttime spectacular (check schedule) — one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created. Free with park admission. Grab a spot around World Showcase Lagoon 30–45 minutes early.

meals.breakfast: Resort food court — quick and budget-friendly ~$6–$10.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — excellent variety and great value. ~$12–$15 per person.
meals.dinner: World Showcase food stands — try small plates from 2–3 countries for a fun, affordable dinner experience. Budget ~$15–$20 per person mixing and matching.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear comfortable shoes and pace yourself. The World Showcase is free to walk through and culturally rich. Many pavilions have free live entertainment throughout the day. Stay hydrated — June in Orlando is hot and humid.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Hollywood Studios at rope drop. Head straight to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge — ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run and, if virtual queue is available, Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance. These are must-do experiences and lines grow quickly.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land (Slinky Dog Dash, Toy Story Mania) and catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular or Muppet*Vision 3D for a seated, air-conditioned break. Great for recharging during the hottest part of the day.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Fantasmic! nighttime spectacular (check schedule) — an epic outdoor show featuring Mickey Mouse and Disney villains. Arrive 45–60 minutes early for good seating. Free with park admission.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before departure — ~$6–$10 per person.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — budget-friendly counter service with toasted sandwiches and lemonade. ~$10–$14 per person.
meals.dinner: Ronto Roasters in Galaxy's Edge — affordable wraps with unique flavors. ~$12–$15 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios has some of the most popular rides at Walt Disney World. Virtual queues and Lightning Lane fill up fast — check the app the moment the park opens. Bring portable phone chargers as heavy app usage drains battery quickly.

day_by_day.morning: Take a well-deserved rest morning at Aegean Bliss Resort. Sleep in, enjoy the beachfront, use the pool, and recharge. This mid-trip break is essential for energy management on a 7-day trip, especially in June heat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney's Animal Kingdom at noon. Explore Pandora — The World of Avatar (Flight of Passage and Na'vi River Journey). Also check out Kilimanjaro Safaris for a free-roaming animal experience — afternoons often have great animal activity.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for Rivers of Light or Tree of Life Awakenings (check schedule) — beautiful, atmospheric evening shows. Explore Discovery Island and DinoLand U.S.A. before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Leisurely resort breakfast or grab groceries from a nearby Walmart/Publix for in-room snacks and savings. ~$5–$8.
meals.lunch: Flame Tree Barbecue at Animal Kingdom — one of the best counter-service meals in all of Disney. Ribs, chicken, and brisket. ~$14–$18 per person.
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — healthy, affordable bowls with great flavor. ~$13–$16 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks — check hours in advance. The safari is best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active. Pandora is stunning at night — try to stay until dark if the park allows.

day_by_day.morning: Return to Magic Kingdom or EPCOT for any missed attractions. Alternatively, take advantage of Disney's free resort transportation to visit Disney's BoardWalk — a free waterfront entertainment district with street performers, shops, and restaurants along Crescent Lake.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Disney's Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach water park (requires separate ticket or park hopper add-on — check if included). If not in budget, spend the afternoon at the Aegean Bliss Resort pool and beachfront — a great free alternative to beat the heat.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Disney Springs for a final evening of free entertainment, shopping, and dining. Catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 if budget allows (~$15–$18 per person) or enjoy the free live music and street performers.

meals.breakfast: Resort food court or in-room snacks bought from grocery store ~$5–$8.
meals.lunch: Pack a picnic lunch from resort or grocery store to enjoy at the BoardWalk or resort beach — great money-saving strategy. ~$5–$10.
meals.dinner: The Polite Pig at Disney Springs — award-winning BBQ, craft drinks, and great value. ~$15–$20 per person.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically the busiest day at Disney parks — consider avoiding the main parks today and opting for free/low-cost Disney experiences instead. Disney Springs is always free to enter and offers a full evening of entertainment.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning — pack bags and check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Store luggage with the concierge if your flight is in the afternoon/evening. Take one last stroll along the resort beachfront and enjoy a relaxed breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on departure time, make a final stop at Disney Springs for last-minute souvenirs, a character meet-and-greet photo opportunity, or simply enjoy the ambiance. Budget souvenir tip: Disney Springs has more affordable merchandise than inside the parks.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport via budget shuttle or rideshare. Arrive at least 2.5–3 hours before international flights. Reflect on an amazing week of Disney magic!

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast — enjoy a proper sit-down or food court meal as a final treat. ~$8–$12 per person.
meals.lunch: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza at Disney Springs — customizable, fast, and budget-friendly. ~$10–$13 per person.
meals.dinner: Airport food court or pack snacks from resort/grocery store for the flight. ~$10–$15.

day_by_day.notes: Use this day to wrap up any missed experiences and purchase final souvenirs. Compare prices — items inside the parks are often 20–30% more expensive than at Disney Springs or the resort gift shop. Keep receipts in case of any exchange needs before leaving Orlando.

day_by_day.morning: Flight arrives at 13:00 — no morning activities scheduled. Use arrival time to transfer from the airport to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World (approx. 25–35 min by shuttle or rideshare). Check in, unpack, and get settled into your Beachfront room.
day_by_day.afternoon: After check-in, take a leisurely stroll around the Aegean Bliss Resort grounds to get oriented. Head over to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required) for a low-key first afternoon — browse unique Disney merchandise shops, explore the waterfront promenade, and soak in the Disney atmosphere without the full-park crowds.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening: Enjoy live street entertainment, browse the remaining shops, and catch the vibrant nighttime atmosphere along the waterfront. This is a perfect, relaxed way to ease into your Disney World vacation.

meals.breakfast: Grab something light at the airport before landing or pick up a snack at the resort welcome café upon arrival.
meals.lunch: Grab a quick bite at Disney Springs — try Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza or Earl of Sandwich for an affordable, satisfying mid-range lunch option.
meals.dinner: Dine at The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — a mid-range waterfront restaurant offering fresh seafood, steaks, and burgers with stunning views of the lagoon. Reservations recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Since the flight lands at 13:00, keep Day 1 light and stress-free. No park tickets needed today — Disney Springs is free to enter. Download the My Disney Experience app tonight to confirm park reservations, check wait times, and set up Lightning Lane selections for the days ahead. Confirm any advance dining reservations for the rest of the week.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Morning): Arrive at Magic Kingdom at rope drop (typically 8:00–9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then cross to Fantasyland for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train — both are high-demand rides best tackled early. Explore Cinderella Castle and stroll through Liberty Square.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Adventure: Ride Big Thunder Mountain Railroad in Frontierland, experience the Haunted Mansion, and take the family through Pirates of the Caribbean. Use Lightning Lane passes strategically for any rides with long waits. Catch the afternoon parade (check the My Disney Experience app for parade times) down Main Street U.S.A.
day_by_day.evening: Stay in Magic Kingdom for the spectacular nighttime show — the Happily Ever After fireworks and projection show over Cinderella Castle is a must-see highlight of any Disney World trip. Grab a prime viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. at least 45 minutes before showtime.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort before heading to the park, or pick up a Mickey-shaped waffle and coffee at The Main Street Bakery (Starbucks) inside Magic Kingdom.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — a mid-range quick-service spot offering clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish platters in a charming nautical setting.
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom's Fantasyland — a beloved mid-range dining experience set inside the Beast's enchanted castle. Book reservations well in advance via My Disney Experience.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase or confirm Magic Kingdom park tickets and Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance. Wear comfortable walking shoes — expect 8–12 miles of walking. Stay hydrated; June in Orlando is hot and humid. Take a mid-afternoon break at an air-conditioned attraction or show if energy dips.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience (Morning): Arrive early at Hollywood Studios to head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge before crowds build. Book a Lightsaber Building session at Savi's Workshop in advance — this is a premium but iconic experience ($250+ per saber) where guests craft a custom lightsaber. Alternatively, build a custom droid at Droid Depot for a slightly lower price point.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Hollywood Studios: Ride Rise of the Resistance (one of the most immersive theme park experiences in the world) and Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Afterward, explore the rest of the park — ride Slinky Dog Dash in Toy Story Land, and experience Tower of Terror or Rock 'n' Roller Coaster for thrill seekers.
day_by_day.evening: Wrap up Hollywood Studios with the Fantasmic! nighttime show — a dramatic outdoor spectacular featuring Disney heroes and villains on a lagoon stage with water screens, fireworks, and live performers. Check show times via the app and arrive 30–45 minutes early for good seats.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy breakfast at the resort — Aegean Bliss Resort likely has a buffet or café option. Fuel up before a big park day.
meals.lunch: Ronto Roasters inside Galaxy's Edge — try the iconic Ronto Wrap (roasted pork and grilled sausage in a pita) and a Meiloorun Juice for an immersive, mid-range Star Wars-themed lunch.
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café at Hollywood Studios — a fun, nostalgic mid-range restaurant serving classic American comfort food (pot roast, fried chicken, meatloaf) in a 1950s TV kitchen setting. Reservations recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop and Droid Depot reservations must be booked well in advance through shopDisney or My Disney Experience — these sell out quickly. Rise of the Resistance virtual queues or Individual Lightning Lane purchases are highly recommended. Check the app first thing in the morning to secure your boarding group or purchase access.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Morning): Arrive at EPCOT when it opens and start with Future World (now called World Discovery and World Nature) — ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (a reverse launch coaster), Remy's Ratatouille Adventure, and Test Track. These are best experienced early before lines build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to EPCOT's World Showcase as it opens at 11:00 AM. Stroll through the 11 international pavilions — sample authentic dishes and snacks from Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, the USA, Japan, Morocco, France, the United Kingdom, and Canada. This is a leisurely, culturally enriching experience perfect for the whole family. Don't miss the Frozen Ever After ride in the Norway Pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular — the EPCOT Forever or Harmonious show (confirm current show name via the My Disney Experience app) over World Showcase Lagoon. Featuring fireworks, illuminated kites, floating set pieces, and classic Disney music, it's a breathtaking finale to the day.

meals.breakfast: Light breakfast at the resort or grab a croissant and coffee at the France Pavilion's Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie upon arriving at EPCOT.
meals.lunch: Graze your way through World Showcase — try a School Bread pastry in Norway, a Bratwurst in Germany, and a Kakigori shaved ice in Japan for a fun, budget-friendly mid-range food tour experience.
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion — a lively mid-range teppanyaki restaurant where chefs cook hibachi-style at your table. Great for families and a memorable cultural dining experience. Reservations strongly recommended.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable park — comfortable shoes are essential. The World Showcase food tour approach means grazing on small plates rather than full meals, which is both cost-effective and fun. Check if any special EPCOT festivals are running during your visit (Food & Wine, Flower & Garden, etc.) as these add even more food and entertainment options.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience (Morning): Arrive at Animal Kingdom at rope drop and head immediately to Pandora — The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage first — it is consistently one of the most in-demand rides at all of Disney World and wait times skyrocket quickly. Use Lightning Lane if available.
day_by_day.afternoon: After Pandora, head to the Kilimanjaro Safari — embark on a thrilling open-air safari through the African savanna to see real lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, hippos, and more. This is a highlight of Animal Kingdom and best done in the afternoon when animals are more active in shaded areas. Follow up with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail walking trail and the Festival of the Lion King stage show.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxed evening back at the Aegean Bliss Resort. Take advantage of the beachfront amenities — swim in the pool, enjoy the resort's evening atmosphere, or simply unwind after several busy park days. This is a great rest evening before the final full park day.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort — take your time this morning since Animal Kingdom opens early but the resort breakfast can be a relaxing start.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — a mid-range quick-service restaurant with creative, healthy bowls featuring grains, proteins, and fresh toppings in a stunning bioluminescent cave setting. Highly rated for both quality and value.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the Aegean Bliss Resort's signature restaurant — enjoy a beachfront dining experience at your own hotel for a relaxed, convenient evening. Alternatively, order in or visit a nearby resort dining option for a mid-range meal.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage is the single most competitive ride at Disney World — prioritize it at rope drop or purchase Individual Lightning Lane access. Kilimanjaro Safari is best in the early morning or late afternoon for the best wildlife sightings. Animal Kingdom typically closes earlier than other parks, so plan your day accordingly and check closing times via the app.

day_by_day.morning: Return visit to a favorite park or explore a missed experience: Use this flexible morning to revisit your favorite park for any rides you missed or want to experience again. Alternatively, explore Disney's BoardWalk — a free-to-enter waterfront entertainment district adjacent to EPCOT with shops, street performers, and a classic boardwalk atmosphere. Great for a relaxed Saturday morning stroll.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head back to Magic Kingdom or Hollywood Studios for any remaining bucket-list experiences — perhaps Tron Lightcycle / Run at Magic Kingdom (a new high-speed coaster), or Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway at Hollywood Studios. Alternatively, spend the afternoon at the resort pool enjoying the beachfront and recharging for the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening (revisit): Return to Disney Springs for a festive final full evening — enjoy live music, browse the World of Disney store (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), catch a movie at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater, or enjoy a special dinner at one of the upscale dining options.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy a leisurely resort breakfast — treat yourself to a slightly nicer spread at the hotel restaurant since this is a more relaxed morning.
meals.lunch: Quick-service lunch in whichever park you visit, or grab a casual bite at Disney's BoardWalk — try the BoardWalk Bakery for sandwiches, pastries, and pizza by the slice.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — a stylish mid-to-upscale steakhouse offering a lively atmosphere, great cocktails, and quality steaks. A slightly elevated splurge dinner to celebrate a wonderful trip. Reservations recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Saturday is typically one of the busiest days at Disney World as local Florida residents and weekend visitors arrive. If revisiting parks, use Lightning Lane passes strategically and check wait times before committing to a specific park. Consider a resort pool day in the afternoon as a crowd-avoidance strategy.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning at Aegean Bliss Resort: Enjoy a relaxed final morning — sleep in, take one last swim at the beachfront pool, or enjoy a slow breakfast with the family. Pack and prepare for checkout. If checkout is late morning, take a final stroll along the resort's beachfront to soak in the last moments of your Disney vacation.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, squeeze in one final Disney experience: Return to your favorite park for a short visit, revisit Disney Springs for any last-minute souvenir shopping, or simply relax at the resort. If time permits, visit the World of Disney store at Disney Springs for final gift purchases — it's the most comprehensive Disney merchandise store available.
day_by_day.evening: Transfer to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before your flight for the resort-to-airport transfer (25–35 minutes) plus airport check-in, security, and boarding time. Carry any Disney treats or snacks purchased during the trip for the flight home.

meals.breakfast: Splurge on a final resort breakfast — enjoy a full sit-down meal at the Aegean Bliss Resort restaurant to celebrate the end of a magical trip.
meals.lunch: Grab a casual, convenient lunch at Disney Springs or a quick-service option near the resort before heading to the airport — try Wolfgang Puck Bar & Grill for a mid-range, satisfying farewell meal.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight meal depending on departure time and flight duration.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm hotel checkout time with Aegean Bliss Resort in advance — many Disney-area hotels offer late checkout for an additional fee, which can be worth it for a stress-free final morning. Use Disney's resort airline check-in service (if available) to check bags at the hotel and receive boarding passes before heading to the airport. Keep all park tickets, Lightning Lane receipts, and dining receipts organized for any potential reimbursements or expense tracking.

Settle into your Beachfront suite and enjoy a welcome amenity.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Orientation & Relaxation: Explore the Aegean Bliss Resort grounds, unwind at the beachfront pool, and take advantage of the concierge desk to confirm all park reservations and Lightning Lane Multi-Pass bookings for the week. Pick up your MagicBands and Disney park tickets.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening: Head to Disney Springs for a relaxed first-night experience. Browse unique boutiques, enjoy live entertainment along the waterfront, and soak in the vibrant atmosphere as a perfect, low-key introduction to the Disney World experience.

meals.breakfast: Enjoy a light meal or snack on the plane or at the airport lounge prior to landing.
meals.lunch: Afternoon welcome refreshments and a light spread at the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront lounge upon check-in.
meals.dinner: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — an upscale modern steakhouse offering premium cuts, craft cocktails, and a lively rooftop ambiance. Reservations strongly recommended.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange private airport transfer before departure. Confirm all park reservations and Individual Lightning Lane selections with the resort concierge upon check-in. Request early park entry wristbands and any VIP tour upgrades for the week. June weather in Orlando is hot and humid with afternoon thunderstorms possible — pack light, breathable clothing and ponchos.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Morning): Leverage Early Theme Park Entry (available to Disney Resort guests) to arrive at Magic Kingdom 30 minutes before official opening. Prioritize top-tier attractions: Tiana's Bayou Adventure, Space Mountain, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad using pre-booked Lightning Lane selections. Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland before crowds build.
day_by_day.afternoon: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Adventure (Afternoon): After a midday break back at the resort to escape peak heat, return to Magic Kingdom for the afternoon. Experience Pirates of the Caribbean, Haunted Mansion, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Catch the Festival of Fantasy Parade along Main Street U.S.A. for a spectacular daytime show.
day_by_day.evening: Magic Kingdom After Dark & Fireworks: Stay for the iconic 'Disney Enchantment' fireworks spectacular over Cinderella Castle. Secure a premium viewing spot on Main Street U.S.A. or book a private fireworks dessert party for an exclusive, elevated viewing experience with reserved seating and gourmet treats.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort's signature beachfront restaurant — a lavish buffet or à la carte spread to fuel the day.
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom (Beast's Castle, Fantasyland) — a beloved prix-fixe lunch in a stunning, immersive setting. Reservations essential.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table — dine inside Cinderella Castle itself for a truly magical, character-dining experience with a refined prix-fixe menu. Book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Book Lightning Lane Individual selections for Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Tiana's Bayou Adventure the moment the booking window opens (7:00 AM on the day of your visit). Consider hiring a Disney VIP Tour Guide for the day for private, skip-the-line access to all major attractions. A midday resort retreat is highly recommended given June heat.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Experience (Morning): Arrive early using Resort Early Entry to Galaxy's Edge. Begin with Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run for an interactive cockpit adventure. Pre-book the coveted Savi's Workshop — Handbuilt Lightsabers experience (a deeply immersive, premium ceremony where you craft your own custom lightsaber, $300+ per person).
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios Full Afternoon: Ride Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of Disney's most technically spectacular attractions. Explore Droid Depot to build a custom droid companion. Then shift to the rest of Hollywood Studios: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (if accessible from this park), Tower of Terror, Rock 'n' Roller Coaster, and catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular.
day_by_day.evening: Fantasmic! Nighttime Spectacular: Cap the evening with Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' legendary outdoor nighttime show featuring Mickey Mouse, water screens, fire, and beloved Disney characters. Upgrade to the Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed premium reserved seating alongside a dinner experience.

meals.breakfast: Early morning grab-and-go breakfast from the resort's premium in-room dining service before heading to the park.
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge — the galaxy's most famous watering hole offering exotic themed cocktails, non-alcoholic concoctions, and shareable bites in a fully immersive Star Wars atmosphere. Reservations required.
meals.dinner: The Hollywood Brown Derby — Hollywood Studios' most elegant table-service restaurant, inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood original. Savor the famous Cobb Salad and refined contemporary American cuisine.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop reservations must be made well in advance (up to 60 days) and sell out extremely fast — prioritize this booking. The Droid Depot experience is walk-up but can have waits; aim for early morning. Fantasmic! Dining Package reservations should be secured simultaneously with park reservations.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour (Morning): Arrive at EPCOT using Early Resort Entry. Begin with Future World (now called World Discovery & World Nature): experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (Individual Lightning Lane essential), Test Track, and Soarin' Around the World for breathtaking aerial visuals. Stroll through the beautifully redesigned World Nature pavilion.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT World Showcase Afternoon Tour: Embark on a self-guided (or concierge-arranged private guided) World Showcase culinary and cultural tour. Begin in Mexico (La Cava del Tequila for premium agave tastings), journey through Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada — sampling signature dishes, wines, and cultural experiences at each pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious Nighttime Spectacular: Stay for EPCOT's spectacular 'Harmonious' (or its successor show) — one of the largest nighttime spectaculars ever created for a Disney park, featuring massive floating set pieces, fountains, fire, and pyrotechnics on World Showcase Lagoon. Book a premium IllumiNations/Harmonious dessert party for reserved lakeside viewing with exclusive desserts and beverages.

meals.breakfast: Breakfast at the resort — enjoy the full beachfront breakfast service before a big day at EPCOT.
meals.lunch: Via Napoli Ristorante e Pizzeria in the Italy Pavilion — celebrated for its authentic Neapolitan wood-fired pizzas and refined Italian fare in an elegant setting.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul in the France Pavilion — EPCOT's most prestigious fine-dining restaurant, offering classic French haute cuisine with a contemporary twist. An extraordinary, Michelin-caliber experience inside a Disney park. Reservations book out months in advance.

day_by_day.notes: The EPCOT Food & Wine Festival (typically August–November) would not be running in June, but the World Showcase always offers rich culinary experiences year-round. Consider booking a private 'EPCOT Food & Culture' guided tour through Disney's private VIP services for an exclusive, curated pavilion-by-pavilion experience. La Cava del Tequila is walk-up only but worth the wait or an early arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience (Morning): Arrive at Animal Kingdom with Early Resort Entry. Head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar: experience Avatar Flight of Passage (the park's crown jewel — a breathtaking soaring banshee ride) and Na'vi River Journey. These are the park's most in-demand attractions — Lightning Lane Individual for Flight of Passage is a must.
day_by_day.afternoon: Kilimanjaro Safari & Wildlife Exploration: Board the Kilimanjaro Safaris for an expansive, open-air safari through Disney's stunning 110-acre savanna, spotting lions, elephants, giraffes, zebras, rhinos, and more in naturalistic habitats. Explore Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Catch a performance of the Festival of the Lion King — one of Disney's most beloved live stage productions.
day_by_day.evening: Rivers of Light & Resort Dinner: Experience the serene, awe-inspiring 'Rivers of Light' nighttime show at Animal Kingdom (if operating) — a luminous water spectacular celebrating nature. Return to the resort for a luxurious evening and a world-class dinner at the resort's signature restaurant.

meals.breakfast: Early in-room dining at the resort — a full premium breakfast delivered to your beachfront suite before the park opens.
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant at Animal Kingdom — Disney's most upscale Animal Kingdom dining experience, celebrating global exploration with artfully crafted dishes and an impressive wine and cocktail program. A true culinary gem.
meals.dinner: Signature dinner at the Aegean Bliss Resort's premier beachfront restaurant — a relaxed, elegant evening enjoying fresh seafood, premium steaks, and curated wines with stunning resort views. A perfect night in.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage is consistently one of the most sought-after Lightning Lane Individual selections across all of Walt Disney World — book it the instant the 7:00 AM window opens. The Kilimanjaro Safari experience is notably different in the morning (animals are most active) vs. afternoon — morning is preferred if possible. Tiffins Restaurant reservations should be made 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure Morning & Resort Luxury: Enjoy a well-deserved, unhurried morning at the Aegean Bliss Resort. Sleep in, indulge in a premium spa treatment (book a couples' massage or signature facial at the resort spa), and enjoy a leisurely breakfast by the beachfront. This is your recovery day before the final full park day.
day_by_day.afternoon: EPCOT or Magic Kingdom Return Visit / VIP Tour Option: Use the afternoon for a return visit to a favorite park — either EPCOT for any missed World Showcase pavilions and cuisine, or Magic Kingdom to catch any remaining attractions. Alternatively, this is the ideal day to book a full Disney VIP Private Tour (approximately $450–$900/hour, 7-hour minimum) for a completely personalized, skip-the-line guided experience across multiple parks.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Farewell Shopping & Dining: Return to Disney Springs for an evening of luxury shopping (World of Disney, Uniqlo, luxury boutiques) and a premium farewell dinner. Enjoy live music and waterfront entertainment as a celebratory send-off to an incredible week.

meals.breakfast: Indulgent in-room or beachfront breakfast at the resort — eggs Benedict, fresh pastries, tropical fruits, fresh-pressed juices, and premium coffee.
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch at the resort — fresh salads, gourmet sandwiches, premium cocktails, and mocktails enjoyed at the beachfront cabana.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — legendary Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Asian restaurant, offering an extraordinary pan-Asian menu with premium omakase options, exceptional cocktails, and an elegant, dramatic interior. One of the finest dining experiences in all of Orlando.

day_by_day.notes: Resort spa appointments should be booked at the start of the trip or before arrival. Saturday is typically the busiest park day of the week — if doing a park visit, a VIP Tour Guide is especially valuable today to navigate crowds efficiently. Disney Springs is free to enter and requires no park reservation.

day_by_day.morning: Final Morning Magic — Magic Kingdom or EPCOT: Rise early for one final Early Entry morning at either Magic Kingdom or EPCOT (whichever you feel deserves one more visit). Enjoy the peaceful early-morning atmosphere, grab any last Lightning Lane experiences, and soak in the magic of Walt Disney World one final time.
day_by_day.afternoon: Resort Checkout & Farewell Luxuries: Return to the Aegean Bliss Resort for a leisurely checkout. Take advantage of late checkout (request this as a luxury guest perk). Enjoy a final swim, a resort cocktail, or a walk along the beachfront. Pack, collect luggage, and arrange your private luxury transfer back to Orlando International Airport.
day_by_day.evening: Departure: Board your departing flight with incredible memories of a world-class Disney World luxury experience. Consider booking a Priority Pass or premium airport lounge for a comfortable pre-flight experience.

meals.breakfast: Final grand breakfast at the resort's beachfront restaurant — a celebratory, leisurely meal with the full premium spread. Order your favorites and take your time.
meals.lunch: Quick-service or light lunch inside the final park visit — Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café (Magic Kingdom) or a World Showcase snack at EPCOT, depending on your final park choice.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or in-flight — if time allows before departure, enjoy a meal at The Edison or another Disney Springs restaurant for a final taste of Orlando dining excellence.

day_by_day.notes: Request late checkout (typically 1:00 PM–2:00 PM) from the resort concierge at the start of your stay to maximize your final day without rushing. Ensure all purchased merchandise, custom lightsabers, and droids are properly packed — Savi's Workshop lightsabers come in a protective case. Confirm private airport transfer timing based on your flight departure. Allow at least 2.5–3 hours before international flight departure for check-in and security at Orlando International Airport.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
